request: Bug: a finished run's checklist reappears when the next run in the same chat starts. clearLiveChecklist(chatId) in src/lib/checklist.ts returns a copy of the store's `live` object without the key, but a Solid store setter merges objects, so the key stays. After clearLiveChecklist(id), liveChecklist(id) must return null, and other chats' lists must be untouched; clearing a chat with no list is harmless; noteChecklist(id, items) replaces a chat's list. The same pattern leaves `pending` set; fix it too. Also clear the chat's live checklist when a run starts (startRun in src/lib/agentRuns.ts), before asking the backend to start.
